# PARALLEL EXECUTION PLAN — SURFACE WRITER WAVES

**Controller:** MiMo-V2.6-Pro · **Writer model:** `xiaomi-token-plan-sgp/mimo-v2.6-flash`
**Dispatch source:** `controller/10_dispatch/SURFACE_DISPATCH_MATRIX.json` (23 units, generated by `tools/build-surface-dispatch.py`)
**Inherited standard:** `controller/09_writer_forge/VISUAL_EXECUTION_STANDARD.md`

**Execution unit:** 1 WRITER → 1 SURFACE → 1 VISUAL OWNERSHIP LOOP.

---

## 1. GLOBAL COLLISION SEAMS (Controller-owned unless stated)

| Seam | Why it collides | Governance |
|---|---|---|
| `dist/**` | **Generated** by `npm run build:runtime` from `stack/native-typescript/`. Every build rewrites the whole tree. | **SERIALIZED.** Writers build only through `tools/writer-serial.sh` (or request a Controller build). Never commit `dist/` from two units at once. |
| `dist-ts/**` | Build-determinism proof tree. | Controller-only. Writers never write. |
| `stack/native-typescript/main.ts` | App composition root. | Owner: `W01-SHELL` |
| `surfaces/m0-controller-composition.ts` | Surface mount dispatcher. | Owner: `W01-SHELL` |
| `foundation/global/shell/navigation.ts`, `cep-destinations.ts` | Global shell + 23 destination registry. | Owner: `W01-SHELL` |
| `foundation/global/preferences/`, `foundation/global/settings/` | Language + direction preference surface. | Owner: `W05-CONFIGURATION` |
| `foundation/extensions.css`, `foundation/workspace*.ts`, `foundation/global/pane-layout.ts`, `region-contract.ts` | Global chrome tokens + slot mechanics. | Owner: `W01-SHELL` |
| `surfaces/composition/w0*-rescue.ts` | Cross-surface rescue composition. | `w01-w02-rescue`→`W01-SHELL`; `w03-rescue`→`W03-SCENARIOS`; `w04-rescue`→`W04-EVIDENCE`; `w05-rescue`→`W05-VALIDATION` |

Any unit may **request** a shared-seam change via `tools/writer-serial.sh`. Direct edits outside owned roots are a packet violation.

---

## 2. DEPENDENCY-DRIVEN WAVES

Waves are sized by **writable-root overlap + donor coupling**, not by convenience.

### WAVE-1 — fully parallel (zero writable-root overlap, no donor coupling)
Six independent surfaces, one writer each:

| Unit | Surface | Writable roots |
|---|---|---|
| `W01-TODAY` | today | `surfaces/today/`, `adapters/today/` |
| `W02-RESEARCH-QUALITY` | rq | `surfaces/rq/`, `adapters/rq/` |
| `W03-SCENARIOS` | scenarios | `surfaces/scenarios/`, `adapters/scenarios/` |
| `W04-EVIDENCE` | evidence | `surfaces/evidence/`, `adapters/evidence/` |
| `W05-AUDIT` | audit | `surfaces/audit/`, `adapters/audit.ts` |
| `W05-CONFIGURATION` | configuration | `surfaces/configuration/`, `adapters/configuration/`, `foundation/global/preferences/`, `foundation/global/settings/` |

`W05-CONFIGURATION` additionally owns the language/direction preference seam (gap **G-20**).

### WAVE-2 — donor-coupled knowledge cluster (serialized with each other)
LIBRARY is a permitted **mechanics** donor for LEARN and VISUALIZE TREE-VIEW. Because donor mechanics may change, these three are serialized against one another:

`W02-LIBRARY` → `W02-LEARN` → `W02-VISUALIZE`

Composition is still surface-specific. This serialization exists only to prevent donor-mechanic thrash, **not** to share composition. **Conceptual cloning remains forbidden.**

### WAVE-3 — remaining operational surfaces (parallel, shared seams via owner)
`W03-ENTERPRISE` · `W03-LABS` · `W03-RUNS` · `W03-RESULTS`
`W04-REVIEWS` · `W04-MASTERY` · `W04-PORTFOLIO`
`W05-HEALTH` · `W05-PROCESSING` · `W05-VALIDATION` · `W05-MANUAL-AI` · `W05-BACKUP` · `W05-RELEASES`

Note: `W03-RESULTS` depends on `W03-RUNS`; `W04-REVIEWS`/`W04-PORTFOLIO` depend on `W04-EVIDENCE` (Wave-1). Those run after their dependency lands.

### WAVE-4 — shell (serialized integration seam)
`W01-SHELL` owns the global chrome seams. Run after Wave-1 visual deltas are known so chrome changes are judged against real content, then regression-check every consumer.

---

## 3. LANGUAGE POLICY — BINDING ON EVERY WAVE (gap G-20)

Arabic and English are **both first-class**. Active language is **user-configurable through Settings**. There is **no permanent Arabic-first or English-first product authority**. References establish visual/layout/interaction intent, **not** product-language preference.

Known defect to fix, not to preserve:
- `stack/native-typescript/foundation/global/preferences/schema.ts` — `locale:{safeDefault:'ar',…}`
- `dist/index.html` — `<html dir="rtl" lang="ar">` baked into the document shell

Direction must follow the active preference; do not bake direction into structure.

---

## 4. LAUNCH RULES

1. Every Writer loads the 4 project skills and `VISUAL_EXECUTION_STANDARD.md`.
2. Every Writer works only its writable roots; shared seams go through the owner or `tools/writer-serial.sh`.
3. Every Writer runs the full visual lifecycle and emits `writer-output/<UNIT>/VISUAL_EXECUTION_REPORT.json`.
4. **Writers cannot accept their own work.** Status stays `NOT_OWNER_ACCEPTED`.
5. Controller independently re-verifies: function, structure, reference fidelity, composition, density, content completeness, responsive, RTL/LTR/BIDI, architecture, shared-component appropriateness, evidence lineage.
